notes: Migrated from run_volatility_premium.py. Under M2_AVAILABILITY|04a35abd the identity below is never used when the empirical link was reachable and failed, which is exactly what happened: 2 of 5 folds.

cost.source: commission-free US ETP; half spread and slippage DECLARED, wider than SPY because a volatility ETP book is thinner, and not measured

monitor.source: CBOE VIX and VIX3M, published daily and distributed through FRED

identity.identity: The position's return is the roll down the VIX futures curve. When the curve inverts the roll is UP it, so the compensation reverses by subtraction rather than by estimation.
identity.parameter_source: the sign change itself, not a level anyone chose
identity.holds_for_range: any curve shape, because the threshold is the sign of the slope and the implication is the sign of the roll

survival.counterparty: buyers of VIX futures and index options: portfolio managers and dealers purchasing protection against equity drawdowns
survival.why_they_accept_losing: they are buying insurance against losses they are mandated or unwilling to bear, and insurance not priced above its expected cost would be written by nobody
survival.what_would_end_it: equity drawdown risk ceasing to be disliked, or enough capital selling volatility to compress the curve below the losses it compensates -- which is what the declared monitor watches for
